status: FROZEN before viewing any 531 Base/TGD2 results
purpose: Predeclared analysis rules for the Base/TGD2 (misspecified-structure) 531-basin experiment. These rules are fixed and must not be modified after 531 Base/TGD2 results exist.
scope: Analysis-only rules; training protocols (IC-CMA-ES / dPL) are the frozen correct-CN gate protocols, reused unchanged with the synthetic target override.

structural_comparisons.rule: All scientific comparisons are within the same parameter-estimation regime.
structural_comparisons.note: R3 is NOT an IC-vs-dPL benchmark; no cross-regime comparison is a primary estimand.

dpl_seed_matching.rule: dPL comparisons are seed-matched between structures

structural_comparisons.ic_restart_rule: Existing IC best-restart selection rule per basin (best train-KGE restart, lowest start breaks ties); no restart matching across structures is invented.

discharge_estimands.baseline: absolute KGE vs q_star per basin for each structure
discharge_estimands.primary: delta_KGE[M] = KGE[M] - KGE[CN]  for M in {Base, TGD2}, within regime
discharge_estimands.reference: Base-no-refit remains the raw structural-knockout reference (results/r3_base_no_refit_v1); it is not a fitted-structure comparison.

parameter_estimands.snow_gradient: association of delta_abs_e (primary) and delta_e (secondary) with frac_snow; frac_snow is an environmental diagnostic axis only, no causal claim
parameter_estimands.cn_only_note: cn_kf/cn_ctg are CN-only diagnostics, not shared-parameter compensation outcomes; never mixed into shared-parameter aggregates.

predeclared_parameter_tiers.rule: Frozen before reading any 531 Base/TGD2 parameter results. Parameters outside the primary/secondary sets may be reported for completeness but must not be promoted into the primary set after results exist.
predeclared_parameter_tiers.interpretation_rule: Poor IC restart recovery is treated as a mixture of optimization instability and practical non-identifiability/equifinality; it is not described as purely optimization instability unless additional evidence separates them.

state_estimands.wd_reason: correct-CN recovery of wd is already poor (gate NRMSE ~1.5-2.5), so it is secondary

derived_total_tension_storage.name: wt
derived_total_tension_storage.definition: wt = wu + wl + wd (total tension-water storage)
derived_total_tension_storage.justification: XAJ defines the total tension-water capacity as wm = um + lm + dm (models/xaj.py); the three layer states wu/wl/wd are the layer storages of that same capacity, so wu+wl+wd is the repository-consistent total tension-water storage. Computed for all structures; reported as a secondary state variable.

state_estimands.paired_cost: delta_E[M] = E[M] - E[CN] for every state metric E, within regime; association of delta_E with frac_snow reported
state_estimands.prohibition: TGD2 storage (tgd_storage) is never compared directly with CN snow storage (G) as the same physical state; TGD2 memory is a temperature-conditioned generic precipitation-memory state.

metrics.periods: train 1981-10-01..1995-09-30, test 1995-10-01..2010-09-30, warm-up 365 days; full-axis recorded-forward export

tables: parameter e / delta_abs_e / delta_e per basin per shared parameter
frac_snow associations/regressions for paired excess errors
